page.title: Webhook Subscriptions
page.subtitle: Configure the external systems that receive outbound webhook events

banner.text_one: still stores the secret unencrypted (saved before encryption was on) — edit and re-enter the secret to encrypt it
banner.text_other: still store the secret unencrypted (saved before encryption was on) — edit and re-enter the secret to encrypt it

secretTitle.plaintext: Set, but not encrypted — edit and re-enter the secret

form.createSubtitle: Register a new receiving system for appraisal events
form.scopeAllDesc: Receives all events except those with their own single-event subscription
form.scopeSingleDesc: Goes to a separate destination for that event
form.createLockedHint: System code and event cannot be changed after creation
form.editLockedHint: Used to match events to a destination. Cannot be changed after creation — create a new subscription instead.
form.callbackUrlHint: After changing the URL the secret must be entered again — the stored one is never sent to a new destination
form.clientSecretPlaceholder: Client secret issued by the receiving system
form.clientSecretHint: Sent with the Client ID to the token endpoint to obtain a bearer token before every delivery
form.secretKeyPlaceholder: HMAC secret agreed with the receiving system
form.secretKeyHint: HMAC-SHA256 secret shared with the receiving system to sign outbound payloads
form.secretPlaintextNote: This secret was saved before encryption was turned on. Press "Replace secret" and enter the same or a new value to store it encrypted.
form.clientSecretReenter: The callback URL, token endpoint or client ID changed — re-enter the client secret.
form.secretKeyReenter: The callback URL changed — re-enter the signing secret.
form.copyFailed: Could not copy — select the value and copy it manually.
form.revealAudited: Every reveal is recorded (who, when, from which IP).
form.createNote: Active as soon as it is created

delete.confirmMessage: This subscription will be permanently removed. Subscriptions with delivery history cannot be deleted — deactivate them instead.
